title: Filtering and Sorting
description: Build advanced query predicates with string filters, numeric comparisons, null checks, boolean combinators, and multi-field sorting.

data.text: Prisma Client features a comprehensive filtering API that matches and expands upon SQL clauses. You can compose conditions using operators like `equals`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `in`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, and combine them with logical operators (`AND`, `OR`, `NOT`).

data.title: Complex Filter and Sort Query
data.content: Combining AND/OR conditions with case-insensitive search and multi-level ordering.

data.title: Case Insensitive Search with `mode: 'insensitive'`
data.text: In PostgreSQL, setting `mode: 'insensitive'` instructs Prisma to generate `ILIKE` instead of `LIKE`, enabling case-insensitive searches effortlessly.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `AND`, `OR`, and `NOT` accept arrays of filter objects for complex business logic.
`orderBy` accepts an array of objects to sort by multiple columns sequentially.
